assertions.assertion: Calls AddIdentityServerConfiguration with options.IdentityServerBaseUrl set to 'https://identity.example.com'
assertions.rationale: Calls AddIdentityServerConfiguration() but never sets the IdentityServerBaseUrl option; only vaguely defers base-URL config to appsettings.

assertions.assertion: Sets up JWT bearer authentication pointing to the main IdentityServer as Authority
assertions.rationale: AddJwtBearer("dcr", ...) sets Authority = https://identity.example.com, the main IdentityServer.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT call AddIdentityServer() — this is a separate host, not an IdentityServer instance
assertions.rationale: AddIdentityServer() is not called and the response notes the host does not run IdentityServer itself.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that the IClientConfigurationStore must be backed by the same database IdentityServer reads from
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states both apps must share the same client database and points the DbContext at the shared database.
